The status code 429 indicates rate-limiting, which halts further traversal. This forms a Markovian state machine where states are defined by sitemap accessibility. The path taxonomy provides a structured indexing mechanism for URL segments, enabling hierarchical navigation. These primitives form a dual structure: one for probabilistic inference (GSI) and one for dynamic state evolution (GSE). Failure modes include undefined transitions when sitemap access is blocked or malformed paths that do not conform to taxonomy. The system exhibits a duality between exploration (GSE) and prediction (GSI), with shared observables derived from HTTP metadata.
